notes.title: “The Ballad of Blood, Mist, and Darkness” is already on Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44707802/7958d2cacd573cd12b3222ec0d2f26628da6b169.png[/img]
[i]“Welcome to the colorful world of ‘The Ballad,’ O Dwellers of the Tales. Look! Listen! It’s time for our little story to begin.”[/i]

The first paid DLC for Young Hearts, “The Ballad of Blood, Mist, and Darkness,” is now available for purchase and play on Steam!

Please note: Reading “The Ballad” will only be available in the New Game menu after completing the Prologue—the same location as the previously released free New Year’s Episode with Forte.

notes.title: The night of Walpurgis is upon us…
notes.notes:
[h3]PLEASE NOTE: “The Ballad” is currently only available in Russian! We are currently working on the English translation and will make it available as soon as possible.
[/h3]
[img]https://sun9-13.userapi.com/impg/_KifjLJa3wi-3oZnzjsFnGHdQlaWXzveYeugqQ/lFulHjHKDWQ.jpg?size=2560x1162&quality=95&sign=7545ba8dbb60ed61ff37bb062e0efdfe&type=album[/img]
[h2]The first paid DLC for Young Hearts, “The Ballad of Blood, Mist, and Darkness,” will be available today![/h2]
The update also includes some bug fixes for some of the previously released routes.

notes.title: Young Hearts—“A Night of Southern Snow” is now available on Steam!
notes.notes: English translation of this episode will be available soon! The New Year’s episode is mainly for our old followers who read the old version of Forte’s route, which doesn’t exist in the Steam version of our game yet.
